{"judgements":[{"id":"row1-ilo0-contentilo","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The ILO (target) is about analysis and design of analog and digital circuits, and the week's content (source) covers design of electronic systems and circuits and differential amplifiers, so it is partly on topic. Gaps: (1) the ILO says "both analog and digital circuits", but the content covers only analog differential amplifiers and general system design, with no digital circuit topic; (2) "develop skills in analysis and design" is vague and gives no observable performance; (3) the content only lists topic names (Design of Electronic Circuits, Differential Gain, CMRR) and does not show circuits being analysed or designed, so the Analyze/Create level is not supported.
